title: AND function monomial average
statement:
Let $w$ be a natural number and $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,w\}$. On the uniform sign cube, let $A_w(y)=-1$ when every coordinate of $y$ is $-1$, and let $A_w(y)=1$ otherwise; write $\chi_S(y)=\prod_{i\in S}y_i$. Then
\[
\mathbb E_y[(1+A_w(y))\chi_S(y)]=
\begin{cases}
2\bigl(1-2^{-w}\bigr),&S=\varnothing,\\
2^{1-w}(-1)^{|S|+1},&S\ne\varnothing.
\end{cases}
\]
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $w$ coordinate indices
